paragraphs: Rav Acha, son of Rav Ika. Gittin 24a, 64b; Megillah 25b; Bekhorot 28b, 45a; Bava Kamma 58b; Eizehu Neshekh 71b; Sanhedrin 42a. Rav Bibi said, etc.; Rav Acha bar Rav Ika demonstrated, Makkot 21b. In Rav Bibi ben Abaye’s name, Keritot 3b. Rav Acha bar Yaakov’s sister’s son, Ketubbot 74. Rabbi Yose bar Chanina challenges his words, Nazir 42a. This requires examination: his father spoke to Abaye, he spoke to Rav Ashi—how could Rabbi Yose bar Chanina, Rabbi Yochanan’s student, challenge him? He objected to Rabbi Acha bar Yaakov. Rabbi Acha bar Tachlifa; Rabbi Elazar of Hagrunya (see there). Rav Huna bar Manoach in his name; Rav Pappa, Nedarim 30a. Rav Pappa spoke to Rav Ashi, Chullin 112, beginning of b; 77b [tractate uncertain]. Hamegaresh 84b: Rav Adda bar Rav Ika. See Idi bar Rav Ika: apparently an error. As for Rav Acha bar Ika’s father, etc., they spoke to Abaye, Avodah Zarah 65a.
